586-678-2511.description:
Cast Priest of Gix by paying its mana cost.
When Priest of Gix enters, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur.
Repeat.

2486-4694-5256-7306.notablePrerequisites:
You control your commander.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2486-4694-5256-7306.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Chef.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, milling the targeted player a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat from step 1.

2577-2921-6664-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2577-2921-6664-7084.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

728-4302-4875.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
728-4302-4875.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Conspiracy, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

4247-5617-6553.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

728-2150-2281.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Hero of the Dunes
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Hero of the Dunes
When Hero of the Dunes dies, Saffi triggers, returning Hero of the Dunes from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Hero of the Dunes enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

2122-6260-7737.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton due to Caradora
Repeat.

215-1376-1849.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four Elves on the battlefield.
215-1376-1849.description:
Activate Priest of Titania by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Priest of Titania from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Priest of Titania by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3129-5660-6441-6462-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-7060-7752.easyPrerequisites: You've cast a noncreature spell this turn.
3259-7060-7752.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7060-7752.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Council of Reeds triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-7060-7752.notes: If you start the combo with multiple Council of Reeds, you'll create a token for each of them. This'll result in you creating more tokens each loop for infinite tokens.

1274-1496-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-1496-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

240-2921-5470-6791.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2775-7084.description:
Activate Slimefoot by paying {4}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
When the Saproling dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters and Slimefoot trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Slimefoot trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the earthbent land, adding {C}{C}.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-6972-7160.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Arcbound Whelp.
When Arcbound Whelp dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Whelp's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Whelp from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

5147-5434-5555-7046.notablePrerequisites: You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
5147-5434-5555-7046.description:
Donate Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1651-1770-1863-6754-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-1770-1863-6754-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-1770-1863-6754-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Eusocial Engineering triggers twice due to Elesh Norn, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

841-4544-5147--106.notablePrerequisites:
You don't control a Ring-bearer.
You have a land card in hand.
841-4544-5147--106.description:
Play a land card.
Dúnedain Rangers and the permanent with a Landfall ability trigger.
Resolve the permanent with a Landfall ability trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Dúnedain Rangers trigger, causing the Ring to tempt you, and causing the creature token to become your Ring-bearer.
Sméagol triggers.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature token.
Resolve the Sméagol trigger, causing an opponent to reveal cards from the top of their library until they reveal a land card, then causing you to put the land onto the battlefield tapped under your control, and your opponent to put all other revealed cards into their graveyard.
Repeat from step 2.
841-4544-5147--106.notes: This combo can be stopped if an opponent runs out of lands in their library, so it is recommended to alternate opponents in between cycles to maximize the amount of iterations.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with at least one +1/+1 counter on it
with four or more quest counters on it

4120-4522-4968.notablePrerequisites: Quest for Pure Flame has at least four quest counters on it.
4120-4522-4968.description:
Activate Quest for Pure Flame by removing four quest counters from it and sacrificing it, doubling the amount of damage sources you control deal this turn.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2 as desired.
4120-4522-4968.notes: You may target a creature you control in step 3 to put +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.

1429-2018-2829.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers if it didn't have a -1/-1 counter, and Luminous Broodmoth triggers if Lesser Masticore didn't have flying.
Resolve the persist trigger, if applicable, returning Lesser Masticore from your graveyard to the battlefield with either a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, if applicable, returning Lesser Masticore from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it if Lesser Masticore is still in your graveyard.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.

1018-2254-5626.notablePrerequisites: You have at least five creature cards in your graveyard, and one of those creature cards has mana value 3 or less.
1018-2254-5626.description:
Cast Songs of the Damned by paying {B}, adding {B} for each creature card in your graveyard.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Skullwinder, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying an amount of {E} equal to Skullwinder's mana value, sacrificing the creature you returned in step 4, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Skullwinder from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Skullwinder enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Songs of the Damned from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2028-2034--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
2028-2034--5.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the persist creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Hexavus' second ability by paying {1} and removing the -1/-1 counter from the persist creature, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hexavus.
Repeat.

864-2665-5733.notablePrerequisites:
Progenitor Mimic on the battlefield as a copy of Eternal Witness.
You control at least one Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
864-2665-5733.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Eternal Witness.
When the Eternal Witness token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2281-2757-2921-5006.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one basic Forest.
You control at least one basic Plains.
2281-2757-2921-5006.description:
Activate a basic Forest and Plains by tapping them, adding {G}{W}.
Activate Earthcraft twice by tapping Lurrus and Saffi, untapping the basic Forest and Plains.
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Lurrus.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Lurrus.
When Lurrus dies, Saffi triggers, returning Lurrus from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Saffi from your graveyard by paying {G}{W}.
Repeat.

618-1872-5200.notablePrerequisites: Sword of the Paruns attached to Kiki-Jiki.
618-1872-5200.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Composite Golem with haste.
Activate the Composite Golem token by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Composite Golem tokens and/or target any other nonlegendary creatures you control.

23-776-1329-5281.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Orcish Vandal do not have summoning sickness.
23-776-1329-5281.description:
Tap Orcish Vandal, sacrificing Herbal Poultice to deal 2 damage to any target.
Tap Emry, targeting Herbal Poultice.
Cast Herbal Poultice.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1339-4052.notablePrerequisites:
"Insect" chosen with Kindred Discovery.
You have a way to draw a card.
1339-4052.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Kindred Discovery triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
Note that this will cause you to lose due to drawing from an empty library unless you can remove a combo piece or win the game.
